patches.title: 10.1.2a | Patch Notes
patches.note_zh: 10.1.2a 是对 10.1.2 热修后的再次回调：The Judgment 在 Zealous 与非 Zealous 状态下的 Divine Light 曲线窗口都被下调，同时继续修正 The Nurse、The Pig、Taurie Cain 与若干碰撞、表现和交互问题。
patches.note_en: 10.1.2a partially rolls back the 10.1.2 hotfix by reducing The Judgment's Divine Light curve windows in both Zealous and non-Zealous states, while also fixing The Nurse, The Pig, Taurie Cain, and a set of collision, presentation, and interaction issues.

patches.title: 10.2.0 | PTB Patch Notes
patches.note_zh: 10.2.0 PTB 以大规模技能平衡为主：新增 Survivor Intent System 文本意图沟通，集中重做 Dead Man's Switch、Dissolution、Blood Favor、Dominance、Nothing but Misery、Thrill of the Hunt，以及 Premonition、Road Life、Spine Chill、Stake Out 等多项技能。
patches.note_en: 10.2.0 PTB is a large perk-balance pass: it introduces the Survivor Intent System for in-match text intent calls and reworks a wide set of perks including Dead Man's Switch, Dissolution, Blood Favor, Dominance, Nothing but Misery, Thrill of the Hunt, Premonition, Road Life, Spine Chill, and Stake Out.

patches.title: 10.1.2 | Bugfix Patch
patches.note_zh: 10.1.2 继续热修 The Judgment：进一步放宽 Zealous 状态下的 Divine Light 转向窗口，为非 Zealous 状态补上短曲线窗口，并让从 Exile 返回的幸存者在更远位置复活且短暂免疫；同时扩展 2v8，加入 Xenomorph、Invoking Salt、Nostromo Wreckage 与一批职业、地图、交互修复。
patches.note_en: 10.1.2 continues tuning The Judgment by widening Zealous Divine Light curving, adding a shorter non-Zealous curve window, and protecting Survivors who return from Exile; it also expands 2v8 with the Xenomorph, Invoking Salt, Nostromo Wreckage, and a broad pass of class, map, and interaction fixes.

patches.title: 10.1.1 | Bugfix Patch
patches.note_zh: 10.1.1 重点修正 10.1.0 上线后的平衡与稳定性：增强 The Judgment 的 Divine Light 转向窗口，重做 The Knight 与木板的追猎交互，下调 Vigil、提前 Repressed Alliance 启动，并集中修复角色、地图、UI 与音频问题。
patches.note_en: 10.1.1 is a post-10.1.0 stabilization patch: it widens The Judgment's Divine Light curve window, reworks The Knight's pallet chase interactions, retunes Vigil and Repressed Alliance, and fixes a broad set of character, map, UI, and audio issues.

patches.title: 10.1.0 | Chorus of Sin
patches.note_zh: 10.1.0 正式服上线 Chorus of Sin：新杀手 The Judgment、新幸存者 Aurora、Gameplay Showcase 教学入口、更多 MMR 行为计分、Exile/Heresy 机制与大范围平衡修复一并落地。
patches.note_en: 10.1.0 launches Chorus of Sin on live servers with The Judgment, Aurora, the Gameplay Showcase, broader MMR action tracking, Exile/Heresy systems, and a wide balance-and-fix pass.

patches.title: 10.0.3 | Bugfix Patch
patches.note_zh: 10.0.3 修正 The Slasher 跨楼层反蹲守判定，调整 Cross-Examination 与多项附加组件，并为 Summer Screams 的 Chaos Shuffle、Lights Out、2v8 周轮换做准备。
patches.note_en: 10.0.3 fixes The Slasher cross-floor anti-camp logic, tunes Cross-Examination and several add-ons, and prepares the Summer Screams rotation of Chaos Shuffle, Lights Out, and 2v8.

store.name: 黎明杀机
store.short_description: 10年恐惧相伴。10年的惊吓与刺激体验。10年的残暴献祭与惊险逃脱。 永久困于邪恶的幻境之中，即使死亡也无法逃脱，这是一场需要勇气和智慧的较量，四名意志坚定的逃生者在残忍对局中面对嗜血杀手。选择一方，进入多人非对称竞技游戏世界，获得最佳恐怖游戏体验。
store.short_description_en: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.
